record.context_brief: existence of complete intersections by edim and multiplicity
record.original_question: Characterize exactly those pairs (e,m) of positive integers for which there exists a complete intersection numerical semigroup Gamma with embedding dimension edim(Gamma) = e and multiplicity mult(Gamma) = m.

evidence.quote: Problem 29 ([EHOOPK22, Question 7.5]). Characterize the pairs (e,m) for which there exists a complete intersection numerical semigroup with edim(Γ ) = e and mult(Γ ) = m.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a cofinite submonoid Γ of (ℕ, +) (equivalently, a subset of ℕ that is closed under addition, contains 0, and whose complement in ℕ is finite). Every numerical semigroup Γ ≠ {0} admits a unique minimal system of generators n₁ < n₂ < ⋯ < n_e with gcd(n₁,…,n_e) = 1; the integer e = edim(Γ) is called the embedding dimension of Γ and m = mult(Γ) = n₁ is called the multiplicity of Γ.

Associated to Γ is the semigroup ring k[Γ] = k[t^{n₁}, …, t^{n_e}], which is the quotient of the polynomial ring k[x₁,…,x_e] by an ideal I_Γ (the toric ideal of Γ). The semigroup Γ is called a complete intersection numerical semigroup if I_Γ can be generated by exactly e − 1 elements (equivalently, the cardinality of a minimal presentation of Γ equals e − 1).

Problem. Determine the set of all pairs (e, m) of positive integers for which there exists a complete intersection numerical semigroup Γ with edim(Γ) = e and mult(Γ) = m. That is, give an explicit arithmetic characterization of those pairs (e, m) ∈ ℤ₊ × ℤ₊ that are realized as (edim(Γ), mult(Γ)) for some complete intersection numerical semigroup Γ.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of fully characterizing the pairs (e, m) realizable as (embedding dimension, multiplicity) of a complete intersection numerical semigroup appears to remain open. Partial results exist (e.g., realizability statements such as the existence of complete intersections with embedding dimension n+1 and multiplicity m for m ≥ 2^n, and structural results via gluings), but no complete arithmetic characterization of admissible pairs (e, m) has been located in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Classes of complete intersection numerical semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies several classes of complete intersection numerical semigroups arising in algebraic geometry, commutative algebra, coding theory and factorization theory, but does not provide a full (e,m)-characterization.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization problem is studied within broader work on classes of complete intersection numerical semigroups, with no complete pair-classification given.

status_evidence.title: Semigroups with fixed multiplicity and embedding dimension
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates numerical semigroups with fixed multiplicity and embedding dimension but without identifying which pairs (e,m) are realized by complete intersections.
status_evidence.claim: Related work addresses fixed (e,m) but does not solve the complete intersection realization problem.
